svg.aria-label: Two charts of iperf3 download throughput per second over five minutes. Top: the same walk with MLO on and MLO off; the averages are close, MLO off has eight seconds at zero early in the walk and a one second dip when it moves to 5 GHz, MLO on has a single zero second. Bottom: a later MLO on walk to the laundry room and back, with a strip underneath showing the 6 GHz link carrying the download at the desk, a full reconnect near the desk, the traffic moving to the 5 GHz link at the far end, and staying on 5 GHz back at the desk.
svg.text: Same route, same stops: MLO on and MLO off
iperf3 download, 5 streams, Mbit/s each second
MLO off: 8 s at zero, phone rejoined 6 GHz from scratch
MLO off moves to 5 GHz, one bad second
MLO on: one zero second, no reassociation
MLO on, desk to laundry room and back: which link carried the download
5 GHz link, same association, no rejoin
next download started back on 6 GHz
Link in use read from show ap debug client-table mlo on the AP. Throughput from the iperf3 server log.
